doc: P3-B2a model_version strings (flexeval_b2.model_version). 'full_a1_b2a' is new (B1 r1 + section genes: dihedral / camber / thickness, native JSBSim increments on <root>_v2b2, energy export). rigid / reduced / full / full_a1 / full_a1_b1 are byte-identical to model_versions_post_p3b1r1.json (no hashed source edited; that file is frozen).

genes.name: wing_dihedral_delta_deg
genes.meaning: uniform geometric dihedral delta (deg, tip up +) on top of the JSBSim baseline

genes.name: wing_tc_root_scale
genes.meaning: multiplier on the baseline t/c at the beam root

genes.name: wing_tc_tip_ratio
genes.meaning: tip t/c multiplier / root multiplier (linear in eta between)

genes.name: wing_camber_root_delta_pct
genes.meaning: additive delta on the thin-airfoil-equivalent max camber m_eq at the root (% chord)

genes.name: wing_camber_tip_delta_pct
genes.meaning: additive delta on m_eq at the tip (% chord); linear in eta

b2_schema.encoding: linear_in_value: value = lo + u*(hi-lo), u in [0,1]; encode = (value-lo)/(hi-lo); no log scale; B2 ranges per aircraft (decode needs the model)

genes.name: wing_chord_taper_1
genes.meaning: chord-multiplier ratio CP1/CP0 (eta 1/3 vs root); area-renormalised

genes.name: wing_chord_taper_3
genes.meaning: chord-multiplier ratio CP3/CP2 (tip vs eta 2/3); area-renormalised

genes.name: wing_twist_mid_deg
genes.meaning: geometric twist at beam eta 0.5 relative to root (deg, nose-up +)

genes.name: wing_twist_tip_deg
genes.meaning: geometric twist at tip relative to root (deg, nose-up +; negative = washout)

genes.name: wing_sweep_qc_delta_deg
genes.meaning: additive delta on baseline quarter-chord sweep (deg)

b1.encoding: linear_in_value: value = lo + u*(hi-lo), u in [0,1]; encode = (value-lo)/(hi-lo); no log scale

rules.ac_hold: wing re-positioned so the Schrenk-weighted quarter-chord x equals baseline
rules.stiffness: EI, GJ, EIv = baseline root constants x (c / c_root_baseline)^ei_taper_exp x structure multipliers
rules.mass: wing mass total fixed (area fixed), distribution ~ c^mass_taper_exp
rules.twist: basic (zero-net) strip load q kappa lw (twist - mean): loads the structure; its rigid pitch moment is a Cm0 shift absorbed by the trim elevator -> no pitch feedback (r1)
rules.flown_wing_bm_reference: J_bm_rms denominator and J_bm_peak allowable use the 1-g root BM without the twist basic load, scaled to the baseline planform (r1)
rules.sizing: wing allowables = baseline-planform design loads x structure gene x (c/c0)^3 at the station

rules.rigid_aero: native JSBSim increments, properties set before IC/trim (no coupler rigid feedback)
rules.camber: thin airfoil (a_L0 = -2 m, cm = -pi m); dCL0 Schrenk mean x stall fade (1 -> 0 over a_s-4..a_s: CLmax change gate-only); DATCOM Cm0 factor; downwash at tail; profile polar Kp[(CL-cli')^2-(CL-cli0)^2] with |CL| = sqrt(aero/cl-squared); structure: aero twist 2 dm in the B1 basic-load builder + strip cm couple (torsion), torque sizing one-sided
rules.thickness: EI,GJ x tau^2; EIv x 1; strength x tau (bend, tip, torque); mass unchanged at fixed gauge; dCD0 Raymer form factor; Korn/Lock wave-drag difference; no CLa change; CLmax gate only
rules.dihedral: lifting-line dClb x cos(sweep) x Mach table; structure: antisymmetric strip load lw sign dGamma per q kappa beta; delta only (no Gamma0 beta loads); node z = -(y-y0) tan dGamma

hash_covers: energy schema + frozen reference (p3b2a_energy_ref.json, this aircraft)
